DLG-SC-LOC-029-15-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-15-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この建物について、ご質問はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-15-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have any questions about this building?

DLG-SC-LOC-029-15-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-15-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昔の建物が、そのまま残っているんですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-15-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 現存建物か復元かを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-15-001-SHARED-02.translation: Has the old building survived just as it was?
DLG-SC-LOC-029-15-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the building is original or reconstructed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-15-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-15-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今見えている建物は復元されたものです。当時の建物の跡とは区別してご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-15-001-SHARED-03.translation: The building you see now is a reconstruction. Please distinguish it from the remains of the building that stood here at the time.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-15-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-15-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 復元するときは、何を手がかりにするんですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-15-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 復元の根拠を質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-15-001-SHARED-04.translation: What evidence do you use when reconstructing it?
DLG-SC-LOC-029-15-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask about the basis for the reconstruction. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-15-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-15-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 発掘でわかった柱の位置や、当時の建築に関する資料などを手がかりにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-15-001-SHARED-05.translation: We use evidence such as post positions discovered through excavation and documents about architecture of the period.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-15-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-15-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 柱の位置は、見学者にもわかるようになっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-15-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 柱跡の表示を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-15-001-SHARED-06.translation: Are the post positions marked so visitors can understand them too?
DLG-SC-LOC-029-15-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about the markers for the post remains. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-15-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-15-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この展示の図で見られます。丸い印が柱の位置です。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-15-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can see them in this exhibition diagram. The round marks show the post positions.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-15-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-15-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 丸が規則的に並んでいますね。この図を見ながら外の跡も見られますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-15-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 展示図と屋外遺構の対応を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-15-001-SHARED-08.translation: The circles are arranged regularly. Can we look at the remains outside while referring to this diagram?
DLG-SC-LOC-029-15-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask how the exhibition diagram relates to the outdoor remains. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-15-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-15-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、この見学会では次に外の表示を見に行きます。図を手元にお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-15-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. On this tour, we will go to see the outdoor markings next. Please keep the diagram with you.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-15-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-15-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、図の丸と外の表示を比べてみます。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-15-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 比較して見学する意向を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-15-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I will compare the circles on the diagram with the outdoor markings.
DLG-SC-LOC-029-15-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you intend to compare them during the visit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-15-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-15-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、外の跡へご案内します。どうぞ見学をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-15-001-SHARED-11.translation: Now I will take you to the remains outside. Please enjoy the tour.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-16-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-16-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 町家の見学にいらっしゃいましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-16-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you come to tour the traditional townhouse?

DLG-SC-LOC-029-16-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-16-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。表から見ると狭いのに、奥まで長いんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-16-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 町家の奥行きについて感想を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-16-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. It looks narrow from the front, but it goes a long way back.
DLG-SC-LOC-029-16-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Share your impression of the townhouse's depth. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-16-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-16-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: そうですね。こちらから奥の部屋まで続いています。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-16-001-SHARED-03.translation: That is right. It extends from here to the rooms at the back.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-16-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-16-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 廊下の途中が明るいですが、あそこは外ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-16-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 明るい空間の構造を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-16-001-SHARED-04.translation: There is a bright area partway along the corridor. Is that outdoors?
DLG-SC-LOC-029-16-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask about the structure of the bright space. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-16-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-16-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 中庭です。部屋に光や風を取り込む役割があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-16-001-SHARED-05.translation: It is an inner courtyard. Its role is to bring light and air into the rooms.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-16-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-16-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 中庭を近くで見たいです。靴はここで脱ぐんですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-16-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 見学時の靴の扱いを聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-16-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like to see the courtyard up close. Do I take off my shoes here?
DLG-SC-LOC-029-16-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask what to do with your shoes during the visit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-16-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-16-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、この上がり口でお脱ぎください。靴は棚に置けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-16-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, please take them off at this raised entrance. You can put your shoes on the shelf.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-16-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-16-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 荷物も大きいので、入口に置いてから上がっていいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-16-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 大きな荷物の置き場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-16-001-SHARED-08.translation: My luggage is large too. May I leave it at the entrance before stepping up inside?
DLG-SC-LOC-029-16-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask where to put your large luggage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-16-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-16-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 入口横のお預かり場所をご利用ください。貴重品はお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-16-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please use the luggage storage area beside the entrance. Keep valuables with you.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-16-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-16-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、荷物を置いて、奥の部屋から中庭を見てきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-16-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 荷物を置いて見学を始める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-16-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I will leave my luggage and look at the courtyard from the room at the back.
DLG-SC-LOC-029-16-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Leave your luggage and start the visit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-16-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-16-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞごゆっくり。お帰りの際は荷物もお忘れなく。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-16-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take your time. Do not forget your luggage when you leave.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-17-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-17-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの像について、何かお知りになりたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-17-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything you would like to know about this statue?

DLG-SC-LOC-029-17-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-17-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 右手と左手の形が違うのは、意味があるんですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-17-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 左右の手の違いの意味を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-17-001-SHARED-02.translation: Does it mean something that the right and left hands have different shapes?
DLG-SC-LOC-029-17-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask what the difference between the two hands means. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-17-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-17-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: はい、手の形で意味を表すことがあります。この展示では解説図も付けています。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-17-001-SHARED-03.translation: Yes, hand shapes can convey meanings. This exhibit also includes an explanatory diagram.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-17-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-17-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 図の言葉が難しいので、この像の手の形を簡単に説明していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-17-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 難しい解説を簡単に説明してもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-17-001-SHARED-04.translation: The wording in the diagram is difficult. Could you explain the shapes of this statue's hands simply?
DLG-SC-LOC-029-17-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask for the difficult explanation to be made simpler. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-17-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-17-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 右手は相手に安心を与える形として説明されています。左手と合わせてご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-17-001-SHARED-05.translation: The right hand is explained as a gesture that reassures others. Please look at it together with the left hand.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-17-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-17-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ほかの像でも、同じ形の手を探してみたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-17-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 比較できる像を探したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-17-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like to look for hands with the same shape on other statues too.
DLG-SC-LOC-029-17-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you want to find statues to compare. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-17-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-17-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 次のケースの像が比較しやすいですよ。高さは違いますが、手の形をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-17-001-SHARED-07.translation: The statue in the next case is easy to compare. Its height is different, but look at the shape of the hands.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-17-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-17-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 細かい指の形が見えにくいです。拡大した写真はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-17-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 細部を見る拡大写真を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-17-001-SHARED-08.translation: It is hard to see the details of the fingers. Is there an enlarged photograph?
DLG-SC-LOC-029-17-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for an enlarged photograph to see the details. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-17-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-17-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、ケース横の解説パネルに手の写真があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-17-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, there are photographs of the hands on the explanatory panel beside the case.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-17-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-17-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: その写真を見てから、二つの像を比べてみます。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-17-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 写真を使って比較すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-17-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will look at those photographs first, then compare the two statues.
DLG-SC-LOC-029-17-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will use the photographs to compare them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-17-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-17-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ぜひご覧ください。見学をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-17-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please do take a look. Enjoy your visit.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-18-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-18-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どの停留所まで行かれますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-18-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which stop are you going to?

DLG-SC-LOC-029-18-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-18-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人から「青葉町」で降りるように言われました。ここから行けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-18-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 目的の停留所を示して路線を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-18-001-SHARED-02.translation: My friend told me to get off at Aobacho. Can I get there from here?
DLG-SC-LOC-029-18-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Give your destination stop and ask about the route. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-18-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-18-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: はい、三番乗り場から出る八番のバスが停まります。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-18-001-SHARED-03.translation: Yes. The number eight bus leaving from bay three stops there.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-18-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-18-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 同じ三番から、ほかの番号のバスも出ますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-18-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 乗り場に来る他路線の有無を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-18-001-SHARED-04.translation: Do buses with other numbers also leave from bay three?
DLG-SC-LOC-029-18-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether other routes use the same bay. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-18-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-18-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 出ます。車体前面に八番と青葉町方面の表示があるかご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-18-001-SHARED-05.translation: They do. Check the front of the bus for the number eight and a sign saying it goes toward Aobacho.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-18-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-18-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 次の八番は何時ですか。三時に友人と待ち合わせています。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-18-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 待ち合わせに合わせて発車時刻を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-18-001-SHARED-06.translation: What time is the next number eight? I am meeting my friend at three.
DLG-SC-LOC-029-18-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask the departure time in relation to your meeting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-18-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-18-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 次は二時十分です。この便なら、青葉町まで二十五分ほどです。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-18-001-SHARED-07.translation: The next one is at two ten. On that service, it takes about twenty-five minutes to Aobacho.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-18-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-18-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 降りる停留所がわからなくなりそうです。車内で名前は流れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-18-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 車内での停留所案内を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-18-001-SHARED-08.translation: I am worried I might lose track of the stop where I need to get off. Are the names announced on the bus?
DLG-SC-LOC-029-18-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask about stop information on the bus. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-18-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-18-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、車内放送があります。表示板にも次の停留所が出ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-18-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, there are announcements. The next stop is also shown on the display.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-18-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-18-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 三番で八番を待って、放送と表示で青葉町を確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-18-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 乗車番号と降車確認方法をまとめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-18-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will wait for number eight at bay three and check for Aobacho using the announcements and display.
DLG-SC-LOC-029-18-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Summarize the bus number and how you will check where to get off. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-18-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-18-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、お気をつけて。いってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-18-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, take care. Have a good journey.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-19-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-19-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ち帰りの柿の葉寿司をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-19-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for persimmon-leaf sushi to take away?

DLG-SC-LOC-029-19-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-19-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。二人で食べるので、十個くらいの箱はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-19-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 人数と希望の個数を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-19-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. Two of us will be eating it. Do you have a box of about ten pieces?
DLG-SC-LOC-029-19-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: State the number of people and how many pieces you would like. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-19-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-19-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 十個入りがあります。さばだけの箱と、さばと鮭の詰め合わせです。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-19-001-SHARED-03.translation: We have ten-piece boxes: one with only mackerel, and one with an assortment of mackerel and salmon.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-19-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-19-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 詰め合わせは、それぞれ何個ずつ入っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-19-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 詰め合わせの内訳を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-19-001-SHARED-04.translation: How many of each are in the assortment?
DLG-SC-LOC-029-19-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask about the assortment's contents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-19-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-19-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: さばが五個、鮭が五個です。

DLG-SC-LOC-029-19-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-19-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: その箱をお願いします。柿の葉は外して食べるんですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-19-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 商品を選んで葉の扱いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-19-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will have that box, please. Do we remove the persimmon leaves before eating?
DLG-SC-LOC-029-19-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose the product and ask what to do with the leaves. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-19-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-19-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、葉を外してお召し上がりください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-19-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, please remove the leaves before eating.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-19-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-19-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家まで二時間ほどかかります。持ち歩き方を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-19-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 移動時間を伝えて保存案内を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-19-001-SHARED-08.translation: It takes about two hours to get home. Please tell me how to carry it.
DLG-SC-LOC-029-19-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State your travel time and ask for storage guidance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-19-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-19-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この商品の保存案内をお付けします。保冷袋もご用意できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-19-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will include storage instructions for this product. We can also provide an insulated bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-19-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-19-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 保冷袋もお願いします。帰ったら、箱の保存表示を読みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-19-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 保冷袋を頼み保存表示を読むと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-19-001-SHARED-10.translation: An insulated bag too, please. When I get home, I will read the storage label on the box.
DLG-SC-LOC-029-19-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask for an insulated bag and say that you will read the storage label. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-19-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-19-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: かしこまりました。ありがとうございました。

DLG-SC-LOC-029-20-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-20-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日は内装用の軽い板を、二階の置き場へ運ぶ担当です。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-20-001-SHARED-01.translation: Today you are assigned to carry the lightweight interior panels to the storage area on the second floor.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-20-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-20-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: わかりました。昨日届いた、青い印の束で合っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-20-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 担当資材の目印を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-20-001-SHARED-02.translation: Understood. Is it the bundle with the blue mark that arrived yesterday?
DLG-SC-LOC-029-20-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Confirm the identifying mark on the materials you are assigned. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-20-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-20-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: はい、青い印の束です。枚数は二十枚あります。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-20-001-SHARED-03.translation: Yes, the bundle with the blue mark. There are twenty panels.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-20-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-20-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二階のどこに置きますか。入口の近くだと、通路をふさぎそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-20-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 搬入先を具体的に尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-20-001-SHARED-04.translation: Where on the second floor should we put them? Near the entrance, they might block the passage.
DLG-SC-LOC-029-20-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask specifically where the materials should be taken. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-20-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-20-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 奥の黄色い枠の中に置いてください。通路には出さないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-20-001-SHARED-05.translation: Put them inside the yellow outline at the back. Do not let them extend into the passage.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-20-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-20-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 午前中は、二階で別の班が作業していますよね。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-20-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 他班との場所の重複を指摘する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-20-001-SHARED-06.translation: Another team is working on the second floor this morning, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-029-20-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Point out that another team is using the same area. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-20-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-20-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 搬入は十時半からに調整しました。田村さんと二人でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-20-001-SHARED-07.translation: We have coordinated delivery to start at ten thirty. Please do it together with Tamura.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-20-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-20-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二人で運ぶんですね。今から、置き場の空き具合を見に行っていいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-20-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 人数を確認して下見を申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-20-001-SHARED-08.translation: So two of us will carry them. May I go and check how much space there is in the storage area now?
DLG-SC-LOC-029-20-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the number of people and offer to inspect the area beforehand. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-20-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-20-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、通路から見てきてください。準備ができたら田村さんとこちらへ戻ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-20-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, look from the passage. When you are ready, come back here with Tamura.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-20-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-20-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 青い印の二十枚を確認して、田村さんと十時半に戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-20-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 数量と集合時刻をまとめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-20-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check the twenty blue-marked panels and return with Tamura at ten thirty.
DLG-SC-LOC-029-20-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Summarize the quantity and meeting time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-20-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-20-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お願いします。では、また十時半に。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-20-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. See you again at ten thirty.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-21-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-21-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日はどのようなお手続きでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-21-001-SHARED-01.translation: What would you like to do today?

DLG-SC-LOC-029-21-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-21-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 引っ越したので、住所と電話番号を変えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-21-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 住所と電話番号の変更を申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-21-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have moved, so I would like to change my address and telephone number.
DLG-SC-LOC-029-21-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request a change of address and telephone number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-21-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-21-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 口座を確認できるものと、新住所が載った本人確認書類を拝見できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-21-001-SHARED-03.translation: May I see something that identifies your account and an identity document showing your new address?

DLG-SC-LOC-029-21-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-21-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらです。新しい電話番号は、このメモに書いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-21-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 口座資料と新連絡先を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-21-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here they are. My new telephone number is written on this note.
DLG-SC-LOC-029-21-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the account documents and your new contact information. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-21-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-21-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。申込書には建物名と部屋番号もお書きください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-21-001-SHARED-05.translation: Thank you. Please also write your building name and room number on the application form.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-21-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-21-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 部屋番号は四〇五です。前の住所に届く予定の郵便物も、新住所へ変わりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-21-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 部屋番号を答えて発送済み郵便の扱いを聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-21-001-SHARED-06.translation: My room number is four-oh-five. Will mail that is due to arrive at my previous address also be redirected to the new one?
DLG-SC-LOC-029-21-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give your room number and ask what happens to mail already sent. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-21-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-21-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: すでに発送した分は変えられません。今後発送する分の送付先を変更します。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-21-001-SHARED-07.translation: We cannot change anything already sent. We will change the destination for mail sent from now on.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-21-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-21-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 前の住所には、家族がまだ住んでいます。届いたものは家族に預かってもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-21-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 旧住所の郵便物の受取方法を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-21-001-SHARED-08.translation: My family still lives at the old address. I will have them hold anything that arrives there for me.
DLG-SC-LOC-029-21-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain how mail at your old address will be received. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-21-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-21-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。新しい住所と電話番号が、こちらの控えと同じかご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-21-001-SHARED-09.translation: All right. Please check that your new address and telephone number match this copy.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-21-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-029-21-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: どちらも合っています。この内容で変更をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-21-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 控えの内容を確かめて変更を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-21-001-SHARED-10.translation: Both are correct. Please make the changes using this information.
DLG-SC-LOC-029-21-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the information on the copy and request the change. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-029-21-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-029-21-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらが控えです。ご来店ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-029-21-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here is your copy. Thank you for visiting.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お忘れ物のご相談ですね。乗っていた列車を覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to report a lost item. Do you remember the train you were on?

DLG-SC-LOC-030-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 九時ごろ着いた列車で、座席の上に紺色の上着を残しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 到着時刻と置き忘れた上着を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I left a navy jacket on top of a seat on a train that arrived around nine.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: State the arrival time and the jacket you left behind. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 列車を絞り込みたいので、どちらの駅から乗ったか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: To narrow down the train, please tell me which station you boarded at.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 海南駅からです。車両の番号は覚えていませんが、後ろの方でした。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 乗車駅と記憶している車両位置を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Kainan Station. I do not remember the car number, but it was toward the back.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain your boarding station and the car position you remember. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: わかりました。ほかの上着と区別できる特徴はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Understood. Does it have any features that would distinguish it from other jackets?

DLG-SC-LOC-030-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 左の袖に小さな白い汚れがあり、内側に名前を書いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 紛失物の袖と名前の特徴を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: There is a small white stain on the left sleeve, and my name is written inside.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe the sleeve and name features of the lost item. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その特徴も届けに記録します。見つかった場合に連絡がつく番号を伺えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will record those details in the report too. Could you give me a number where we can contact you if it is found?

DLG-SC-LOC-030-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この番号にお願いします。仕事中に出られなかったら、折り返してもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 連絡先を提示して不在時の折り返しを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please use this number. If I cannot answer while working, may I call back?
DLG-SC-LOC-030-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give your contact number and ask about calling back if you miss the call. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、着信に気づいたら窓口へご連絡ください。受け取り場所は確認できてからお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. When you notice the missed call, please contact the service counter. We will tell you the collection location after it has been confirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は探しに戻らず、連絡を待ちます。届けの控えをいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 連絡を待つ判断と届けの控えを求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will wait to be contacted rather than go back to search today. May I have a copy of the report?
DLG-SC-LOC-030-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will wait for contact and request a copy of the report. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらが控えです。上着が見つかるとよいですね、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here is your copy. I hope your jacket is found. Please take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 予約票の注意書きで、わかりにくいところはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is anything in the notes on your appointment slip difficult to understand?

DLG-SC-LOC-030-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 検査の前は食事を控えるとありますが、水も飲めないのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 検査前に水を飲めるか質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: It says to avoid eating before the test. Does that mean I cannot drink water either?
DLG-SC-LOC-030-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can drink water before the test. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 飲み物の条件は検査によって違います。予約票を確認させてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Conditions for drinks differ depending on the test. Please let me check your appointment slip.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この検査です。今朝はまだ何も食べたり飲んだりしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 対象検査と当日の飲食状況を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is this test. I have not eaten or drunk anything yet this morning.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Identify the test and describe what you have eaten and drunk today. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当部署に確認しますので、少しお待ちください。普段飲んでいる薬はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check with the relevant department, so please wait a moment. Do you take any regular medication?

DLG-SC-LOC-030-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 毎朝飲む薬があります。食事を取らないので、今日は飲まずに持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 常用薬を服用せず持参した状況を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have medicine I take every morning. Since I am not eating, I brought it without taking it today.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you brought your regular medication without taking it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 薬を飲む時刻も担当者に確認します。お薬の名前がわかるものはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will also ask the staff when you should take it. Do you have something showing the medicine's name?

DLG-SC-LOC-030-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お薬手帳を持っています。検査後に飲むかどうかも、一緒に聞いていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 薬の資料を提示して検査後の服用も相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have my medication record book. Could you also ask whether I should take it after the test?
DLG-SC-LOC-030-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Present your medication information and also ask about taking it after the test. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 手帳も添えて確認します。返事があるまでは、こちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will check with the record book as well. Please wait here until we have a reply.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: わかりました。指示を聞き違えないよう、答えを予約票に書いてもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 飲食と服薬の指示を書面で残すよう求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. So I do not mishear the instructions, I would like the answer written on my appointment slip.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask for written instructions about eating, drinking, and medication. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認した内容を一緒にメモしましょう。それでは、担当者に確認してまいりますので、失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let us write down the confirmed information together. I will go and check with the staff now. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの商品の金額について、ご確認ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to check the price of this product, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-030-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 棚では百九十八円と見たのに、レジでは二百四十八円になっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 棚札とレジ価格の相違を具体的に示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I saw one hundred ninety-eight yen on the shelf, but the register shows two hundred forty-eight yen.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Specify the difference between the shelf label and register price. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 同じ大きさの商品か、棚の表示を確かめてきます。商品はこのヨーグルトですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check the shelf label to see whether it refers to the same size. The product is this yogurt, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-030-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、四百グラム入りです。値札はすぐ下にありました。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 価格確認する商品の容量と札の位置を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, it contains four hundred grams. The price label was directly below it.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State the size of the product whose price is being checked and the label's position. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 棚を見たところ、百九十八円の札は隣の小さい商品用でした。こちらの札が少しずれていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I checked the shelf. The one-hundred-ninety-eight-yen label was for the smaller product beside it. This product's label had shifted a little.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: そうだったのですね。小さい方だと何グラム入っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 隣の安い商品の容量を質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I see. How many grams does the smaller one contain?
DLG-SC-LOC-030-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask the size of the cheaper product beside it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 二百グラムです。大きい方をこのまま購入するか、変更されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Two hundred grams. Will you buy this larger one, or would you like to change it?

DLG-SC-LOC-030-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は一人分だけなので、小さい方に替えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 一人分に合わせ小容量へ変更を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I only need enough for one person today, so please change it to the smaller one.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to change to the smaller size to suit one person. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。レジの商品を入れ替えますので、大きい方はこちらでお預かりします。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Certainly. I will swap the item at the register, so I will take the larger one here.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。入れ替えたあとの金額を見てから支払います。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 変更後の合計確認を支払い前に申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I will check the amount after the swap before paying.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask to check the updated total before paying. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 画面に新しい合計が出ました。お買い上げありがとうございます、またお越しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: The updated total is on the screen. Thank you for your purchase. Please visit again.
